fields.statement: At 26fb806ba I read the diff and ran the scoped tests in a detached worktree outside ~/code with fakes only. TestDaemonAutoUpdateSetting (internal/api; fake git and make) passes: autoUpdate unset or off runs no git or make; main with a registered project whose go.mod is not Rhiza's logs 'no registered project is Rhiza's source checkout' and runs nothing; main with a Rhiza checkout runs git fetch origin main, git merge --ff-only and make update exactly once over two polls. internal/daemon passes, including TestRhizaCheckoutFindsModule (finds the project by module path, false when there is none) and the existing SelfUpdate tests. TestScripts/daemon-settings passes and shows rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate = off (default, machine). gofmt and go vet are clean. Inside ~/code the api package fails only on the enclosing-root guard, because the live daemon rewrites .rhiza-root/usage.live.json; the test does not cause it.
